summary: Baidu filed a Form 6-K attaching a Hong Kong Exchange Next Day Disclosure Return (FF305) dated September 8, 2026, disclosing open-market buybacks of its Hong Kong-listed Class A ordinary shares (stock code 09888). The company repurchased 545,000 shares on September 7 at HKD 91.6772 and 554,150 shares on September 8 at HKD 90.2251, each about 0.025% of issued shares, with 2,209,541,178 Class A shares outstanding and no treasury shares. The repurchased shares await cancellation. Watch pace and price discipline, cancellation timing, and any broader capital-return program expansion.
